prompt:
Requested aspect ratio: 9:16. Render a complete 100% full-bleed vertical 9:16 2D endcard illustration extending continuously to all four edges with zero letterbox bars, zero subtitle boxes, and zero dark vignette.

Visual Style (ch_organ_buddies): Clean 2D kawaii medical-explainer illustration: smooth medium black outlines (#222222), flat unshaded fills in soft organ pink (#F4A6A6), stomach peach (#F6C28B), liver maroon (#A23E48), lung rose (#F28C9B) and calm blue (#7FB3D5) on a flat solid white canvas (#FFFFFF); organs drawn as simplified anatomically recognizable characters with tiny faces, stubby arms and expressive eyebrows; orthographic 2D, no gore, no realistic anatomy textures, no gradients, no 3D. Palette: #FFFFFF, #F4A6A6, #F6C28B, #A23E48, #F28C9B, #7FB3D5.

Character Cast: Recurring organ characters: Tim (heart) brave and loud, Dạ Dày (stomach) dramatic complainer, Gan (liver) tired hard worker, Não (brain-shaped round pink blob) overthinking boss; plus a simple doodle human host with a round white head. Outfit: Organs have no clothing; the human host wears a flat calm-blue (#7FB3D5) T-shirt.

Scene Composition: The channel character stands centered in the frame, pointing upwards with a welcoming smile. Clean, minimalist composition with at least 60% open negative space on the solid flat background.

Emphasis lettering instruction: render exact uppercase Vietnamese hand-lettered text in the upper third integrated directly onto the flat canvas (strictly zero rectangular text cards, banners, or gradient overlays covering artwork): "BẢN ĐẦY ĐỦ TRÊN YOUTUBE" and "CƠ THỂ KỂ".
